messages:
anya (support): FYI — Acme in prod seeing intermittent structured_json parse failures since last deploy. Error: \"invalid JSON\". They say sometimes \"id\" comes back quoted (\"12345\") and other times unquoted (12345). Also \"active\" shows up as null vs false. Billing spike from fallback model for ~20m. Request id: req_0a1b2c. Can eng take a look?

mike (eng-ml): can you paste the exact prompt + model + JSON mode settings? is this only when streaming? :thinking_face:

anya (support): Model: redwood-std-instr-13b. structured_json: strict=true. It *appears* correlated with streaming responses. Customer reports 3/100 failures. Quick repro I ran below (very small):

anya (support): ```bash
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-std-instr-13b","stream":true,"input":"Generate invoice JSON for order 12345 with fields id,amount,active"}'
```

anya (support): observed streamed chunks (broken example):

anya (support): ```
data: {"event":"response","payload":"{\"id\":\"123

# <--- stream cut here, client assembled and got invalid JSON
```

anya (support): successful non-streamed return looked like:

anya (support): ```json
{"id":12345,"amount":1999.0,"active":false}
```

ops-bot: log: request=req_0a1b2c route=/v1/generate model=redwood-std-instr-13b stream=true chunks=5 last_chunk_bytes=128 parse_errors=1

tara (eng-platform): I see a recent flush change on the streamer (flush threshold 512 bytes). tagging @mike. Can anyone paste the exact request_ts & customer cluster region so I can pull transport logs?

anya (support): request_ts=2415006742, region=us-west-2. I attached the chunk-assembly log snippet in the ticket (link).

mike (eng-ml): initial hypothesis: tokenization + streaming boundary => numeric literal split across chunks OR model sometimes emits quoted numerics depending on sampling. With strict structured_json we expect stable types; however if the model emits a quoted number sometimes the downstream parser will flip types. For the truncation case, assembler may be rejoining wrong or dropping a quote. I'll reproduce locally with varying chunk sizes.

zach (billing): noted on billing side — fallback to non-dedicated model charged ~25k tokens during the incident window. I'll prepare a provisional credit if this is a platform bug. tagging finance.

mike (eng-ml): repro plan: write harness to force chunk boundaries at byte offsets 1..1024, run the same prompt with stream=true 1k runs, detect invalid JSON, capture whether id emitted quoted vs unquoted and whether chunk split occurred mid-token.

tara (eng-platform): I'll backfill transport logs and verify assembler code path for stream concat. If we find assembler dropped a byte or mishandled newlines we'll patch.

anya (support): customer is on our Dedicated plan and needs a rollback option. Can we pin them to non-streaming or rollout previous streamer config temporarily?

mike (eng-ml): yes, mitigation: config flag to disable streaming for that customer route OR enable server-side reassembly that validates JSON chunks before forwarding. I'll prioritise a quick fix and a longer-term testcase.

anya (support): created internal ticket INF-4129 and set priority P1 for triage. assigning to @mike and @tara. I'll update the customer with mitigation and provisional credit note from @zach. :thumbsup:

mike (eng-ml): thanks — reproducing now, will post findings and minimal repro snippet.

tara (eng-platform): I'll create a temporary rule to force stream=false for that tenant and monitor.

zach (billing): I'll queue the credit and hold billing actions pending eng confirmation.

anya (support): thanks team — I'll keep the thread updated and paste the minimal failing chunk sequence when @mike has it.
